changelog:
Initial release of tg-search.

- Search public Telegram channels and groups by keyword.
- Returns up to a specified number of results as JSON.
- Requires an already-authorized Telethon session on this VPS.
- Supports both English and non-English queries.
- Only public, searchable channels and groups are included.
summary: Searches public Telegram channels and groups by keyword and returns up to 50 matching results as JSON using an authorized Telethon session.
